messages:
maria: kicking off config-only deploy to target tail latency on /v1/generate. canary 2% for 10m, then evaluate.

deploy-bot: (deploy) canary started by maria — id: canary-4822334560. targets: route:/v1/generate, model:rw-v2-small, 2% traffic.

omid: which exact params are we changing?

maria: patch:
```
route:/v1/generate {
  max_concurrent_requests: 60 -> 45
  request_timeout_ms: 12000 -> 9000
  routing_policy: prefer-low-latency -> prefer-cost (soft)
  batching.window_ms: 8 -> 6
}
```

ashley: lowering concurrency makes sense. watch p95, tail qlen, batch size. the routing_policy soft pref could send some tenants to rw-v1-small — is that pinned for enterprise?

maria: added pinlist for enterprise customers so those keep rw-v2-small. routing_policy is a soft hint: only routes to cheaper compatible variants if latency SLOs are met. no forced model swap.

ashley: add rollout note to the release doc and annotate the canary: note enterprise pins, metric owners, and quick rollback commands. :memo:

sam: rollback plan?

maria: quick rollback triggers:
- p95 latency > baseline_p95 * 1.8 for > 3m
- error rate (5xx) > 0.8% sustained for > 5m
- avg batch size drops < 0.8x baseline (indicates bad batching)

manual rollback command (ops):
```
deploy-bot: rollback canary-4822334560 --scope route:/v1/generate
```

automatic fallback: if p95 spikes > 2x baseline we'll auto-fall back to previous config and notify #eng-oncall.

oncall-bot: ops alerting subscribed to this canary. will page if triggers hit. :bell:

ashley: also log a note in the change window doc: evening quiet window applied, monitoring window 30m after full rollout.

maria: will hold until 10m canary completes then post canary metrics snapshot. thanks all.

deploy-bot: canary completed: 2% for 10m — next action: wait for maria audit.

maria: posting quick metrics snapshot in 5m. please flag anything odd.
